title: Sydney Ohr
text:
Hello! My name is Sydney Ohr and I am a rising senior at Macalester College pursuing a B.A in Data Science. I am passionate about using data to tell stories and solve problems, and I am excited to continue learning and growing in the field of data science.

Education
Macalester College | St. Paul MN

Relevant Coursework: Database Management, Statistical Machine Learning, Intermediate Data Science, Object Oriented Programming, Linear Algebra
In Progress Courses: Computational Biology, Probability, Projects in Data Science

title: Fashion Transparency Index
text:
In collaboration with two other peers, I created a Shiny App using data from the Fashion Transparency Index to shine light on what fashion companies were being honest with their sustainability efforts in hopes that consumers could hold brands accountable.
Product
Fashion Transparency Index App

title: STEAM Summer Project
text:
In collaboration with Dr. Kelsey Grinde along with two Macalester peers, I helped debug and increase user experience of Dr. Grinde’s R package, STEAM. I contributed to the in progress work of implementing parallel processing and experimenting with packages such as Rccp and RcppParallel.
